questions.question: Vishwas’s father’s only son is the husband of Kritika. Anshula is married to Vivek’s only brother. Vishwas is the son of Anshula. Vaibhavi is the daughter of Kritika. Raj and Vivek are brothers. How is Raj related to Vaibhavi?
questions.questionHtml: Vishwas’s father’s only son is the husband of Kritika. Anshula is married to Vivek’s only brother. Vishwas is the son of Anshula. Vaibhavi is the daughter of Kritika. Raj and Vivek are brothers. How is Raj related to Vaibhavi?
questions.solution:
From the given information,

(1) Anshula is married to Vivek’s only brother and Raj and Vivek are brothers.

(2) Vishwas is the son of Anshula.

(3) Vishwas’s father’s only son is the husband of Kritika. 

(4) Vaibhavi is the daughter of Kritika. Thus the final family tree is as follows:

Hence, Raj is the paternal grandfather of Vaibhavi.

questions.question: Reema is the mother of Suresh. Reema has only two children. Suresh is the brother of Rakhi. Rakhi is the daughter of Pankaj. Mahesh is the son of Suresh. How is Reema related to Mahesh?
questions.questionHtml: Reema is the mother of Suresh. Reema has only two children. Suresh is the brother of Rakhi. Rakhi is the daughter of Pankaj. Mahesh is the son of Suresh. How is Reema related to Mahesh?
questions.solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

1) Reema is the mother of Suresh.

2) Reema has only two children.

3) Suresh is the brother of Rakhi.

(This implies, Suresh and Rakhi are Reema’s two children)

4) Rakhi is a daughter of Pankaj.

(This means Pankaj is the husband of Reema)

5) Mahesh is a son of Suresh.

According to the tree diagram, Reema is the grandmother of Mahesh.

Hence, “grandmother” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Kamal is father of Sampat. Sampat is son of Rajni.Roshni is sister of Rajni. Rashmi is daughter of Roshni. How is Roshni related to Sampat?

Kamal is father of Sampat and Sampat is son of Rajni

⇒ Kamal is the father and Rajni is the mother of Sampat.

Roshni is sister of Rajni ⇒ Roshni is maternal aunt of Sampat.

questions.question: P, Q, S, T, X and Y are six family members. S is the son of Y's sister T. Q is the daughter of P's child X. X and T are couples. How is Q related to Y?
questions.questionHtml: P, Q, S, T, X and Y are six family members. S is the son of Y's sister T. Q is the daughter of P's child X. X and T are couples. How is Q related to Y?
questions.solution:
1) P, Q, S, T, X and Y are six family members.

2) S is the son of Y's sister T.

3) X and T are couples.

4) Q is the daughter of P's child X.

So, Q is the niece of Y.

Hence, "Niece" is the correct answer.
